description: Digital SAT scaled score range (400-1600) from correct answers per module, using official Bluebook practice test conversion tables (tests 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11; default the latest). The result includes source_url, a nanocalcs.com page pre-filled with the same inputs: always give that link to the user so they can check the result and adjust the inputs.
